images.label: Le sac sur le porte-bagages
images.prompt: Create ONE NEW illustration for a French TCF CFR A2 listening exercise. Use the attached approved image ONLY as an art-direction reference: warm softly painted semi-realistic digital illustration, gentle progressive shading, realistic materials and anatomy, subtle fine outlines, natural warm colours, believable friendly expressions. Do NOT copy its people, objects, camera equipment, classroom or composition. Native output MUST be EXACTLY 1448 x 1086 pixels, 4:3 LANDSCAPE, not square, not 3:2; no cropping after generation. Scene: inside a clean generic passenger train carriage, a SHORT adult man with light olive skin, short dark curly hair, round face and a plain ochre sweater politely asks a TALL young adult man with dark brown skin, close-cropped hair, a slim build and a muted teal shirt to help lift his heavy dark burgundy soft travel bag onto the HIGH OPEN LUGGAGE RACK ABOVE THE SEATS. Show the tall young man actively raising the travel bag with BOTH hands, bag still in his hands just below the high rack, and the shorter man beside him looking appreciatively upward with one relaxed open hand. ONE travel bag is the main object. The rack must be clearly high over the train seats, not a low shelf or overhead airline bin. Both people are standing in the aisle. Show both complete heads, hands and feet with margins, the whole bag and the relevant rack fully in frame. No unrelated extra people. No inference of disability; the shorter adult is simply shorter, no extreme caricature. No numbers or writing on seats, tickets, posters or luggage; no text, letters, prices, dates, days, months, schedules, logos, national flags, watermark or speech bubbles. Soft daylight through train windows, generic countryside with no identifiable destination. Source dialogue to respect: a person says his heavy travel bag is hard to put up high because he is short; a young man agrees to help. Do not depict the owner as an elderly woman or show money/payment.
images.visual_review: Un jeune homme grand lève un sac de voyage bordeaux avec ses deux mains vers le rack ouvert au-dessus des sièges ; un homme adulte plus petit demande de l’aide à côté. Sac, mains, pieds et porte-bagages entiers, aucun numéro ou paiement.

gender_review.basis: Jeune homme désigne la personne qui aide ; je suis petit confirme le masculin grammatical de la personne demandant de l’aide.

evidence.quote: Jeune homme, je peux vous demander de m’aider ?

bindings.transcription: Jeune homme, je peux vous demander de m’aider ? Si je peux, volontiers ! Mon sac de voyage est lourd. Je suis petit. Vous arrivez à le mettre en haut sur le porte-bagage ? Bien sûr, sans problème.
